distinguishing_features: Non-contact high-gradient magnetic field capture of paramagnetic/ferromagnetic fines rather than chemical dosing or operating-point modulation
Introduces a magnetic separator apparatus (WHIMS) not present in any prior art
Exploits magnetic susceptibility force F=(χV/2μ₀)∇(B²) rather than supersaturation or cohesive-force reduction
Removes sub-50 µm particles via magnetophoresis versus drag
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to physically separate fine paramagnetic iron-bearing and thorium-bearing particulates from a rare-earth leachate stream without adding reagents or filter media that clog.
parsed.viable_reason: WHIMS is an established industrial technology and the magnetic-force-over-drag calculation supports capture of iron fines at the stated scale.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: None of the prior art uses magnetic separation; applying high-gradient magnetic capture to this leachate is a mechanism-class departure not suggested by the cited dosing/operating-point approaches.
